item.title: NDPC launches investigation into Temu over alleged data privacy violations
item.description: Nigeria’s NDPC has launched an investigation into eCommerce giant Temu over alleged data privacy violations.

item.title: Anthropic and Rwanda partner to tackle malaria and cervical cancer with AI
item.description: Anthropic has signed a three-year deal with Rwanda to deploy AI against malaria and cervical cancer. The partnership could signal a new wave of AI collaborations between African governments and global tech firms.

item.title: MTN Group proposes $6.2 billion buy-out of IHS Towers
item.description: MTN Group proposes a $6.2 billion buy-out of IHS Towers, which will give the telecom company 100% of IHS''s shares.

item.title: MTN’s $6.2 billion IHS acquisition to face Nigerian regulatory review
item.description: Nigeria’s communications ministry will assess MTN’s $6.2 billion plan to fully acquire IHS Towers, citing concerns over competition, infrastructure control and the broader impact on the telecom sector.

item.title: MTN strikes $6.2B deal to acquire IHS Towers, taking full control of the company
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we look at MTN's $6.2 billion deal to acquire IHS Towers, Nigeria's data probe into Temu, and TikTok deleting 580K Kenyan videos following an AI sweep.

item.title: G-rani wants to formalise Kenya’s informal carpooling culture
item.description: G-rani is turning Kenya’s informal carpooling culture into a structured, affordable mobility option, helping commuters share rides and cut fuel costs.

item.title: Gigalayer acquires Registeram to bolster its market position
item.description: Gigalayer has acquired Nigerian domain registrar Registeram in an all-cash deal, deepening its infrastructure play.

item.title: Why MTN’s buyback of IHS Towers makes economic sense
item.description: MTN's decision to spend top dollars to buyback the remaining 75% shares of IHS Towers in an all-cash deal makes perfect sense.

item.title: These South African innovators are building a platform that guarantees your ads will convert
item.description: After seeing how easily people ignore online ads, these founders built a platform that lets brands create interactive ad experiences across the web.
